note: Holder perks for EMI. Add an entry per collection that gives EMI holders access. Nothing here is shown until it is real.

fields.status: open | upcoming | closed. A date in the past forces closed.
fields.date: optional ISO date, e.g. 2026-10-04. Used to sort and to auto-close.
fields.note: optional, one line on what it is
fields.claim: optional, how to claim. Holders only.
fields.url: optional, where to go. Holders only.
fields.chain: optional, e.g. Bitcoin Ordinals, Robinhood, Base
